Allegations of Exam Paper Leaks Spark Protests and Calls for Reform

Multiple Indian exams, including NEET and UGC-NET, are facing allegations of paper leaks, leading to student protests and political criticism. Authorities have extended the judicial custody of two individuals accused in the NEET case, while students and politicians are demanding action against the National Testing Agency (NTA). The incidents have prompted calls for a comprehensive reform of India's education system.
